title: An Interpretable N-gram Perplexity Threat Model for Large Language Model Jailbreaks
reasoning: The paper focuses on adversarial security and the development of a threat model for jailbreaks. While it utilizes safety-alignment benchmarks (like HarmBench) to evaluate these attacks, its primary contribution is a technical method for evaluating attack fluency and computational cost via n-gram perplexity, rather than a specific evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
